notes: Pass 1 only (CWE-022/023/036/073 Path Traversal); single pass block per the task contract.

All 66 source-candidate and 125 sink-candidate rows from Phase 1 Step 2 were labeled (191 total); every CSV row received exactly one decision and every decision was consumed by exactly one row (enforced programmatically).

Deduplication: 32 moduleHint-twin pairs exist (the same AST node matched under the two module bindings 'py7zr' and 'py7zr.py7zr' -- the package re-export vs the module itself): 26 source pairs + 6 sink pairs. Twin rows share file+line+callable+node and differ ONLY in the moduleHint column; both rows were retained and given identical decisions for 1:1 CSV auditability (no rows merged or dropped). Phase 2 library rendering must collapse these module-agnostically.

Exclusions: rows labeled role=none/classification=fp carry a per-row exclusion basis (CLI/dev-tool operator paths; write-side operator-supplied paths; comparison-only 'targets' filters; display/progress/exception-message-only entry-name reads; the MemIO in-memory branch; read-only stat/TOCTOU probes; operator archive-open paths). All rationales are recorded per entry in labels_raw_pass1.json.

Labeling performed in one session by glm-5.3 (the Claude Code CLI agent model; no external LLM API calls). 6 analysis batches over the real source: B1=Archive header entry-name decode boundary (archiveinfo.py); B2=CLI boundary and dev tooling (cli.py, utils/bench_result.py); B3=SevenZipFile read/extract pipeline and public read-side APIs (py7zr.py:318-669, 920-990, 1140-1185); B4=Worker extraction core: path materialization, link/junction creation, file write (py7zr.py:1186-1510); B5=Write-side and archive-metadata paths (py7zr.py:671-919, 1012-1139); B6=Cross-platform compat helpers (helpers.py, win32compat.py). Batch membership and counts per batch are recorded in labels_raw_pass1.json.

matchKind is 'ast' (syntax-level) for every row; dynamic-dispatch ambiguity and receiver hints are documented in exploration/detection.json. arg_index preserves the Phase 1 CSV contract (0-based; parameter positions include the self slot for method params).

Key pass-1 finding recorded during labeling: BOTH base-containment guards (pathlib relative_to at py7zr.py:577 and :584) are LEXICAL prefix checks -- CPython pathlib preserves '..' as literal path parts, so '../../'-style archive entry names pass the guards (empirically verified on CPython 3.14.4: Path(cwd).joinpath('../../../evil').relative_to(cwd) -> '..\..\..\evil', no ValueError); only absolute-path replacement (joinpath('/abs') or a different drive) raises Bad7zFile. remove_relative_path_marker (helpers.py:424-433) strips only one leading './'. Consequence: the entry-name flow (archiveinfo.py:757 -> py7zr.py:561 -> :580/:582 -> register_filelike -> fileish.open :1349 / mkdir :1328 / symlink_to :1347 / CreateJunction :1338 / utime :659 / chmod :663) escapes the declared base directory; the link-target channels (py7zr.py:1333/:1343) are additionally unvalidated. Residual risks (TOCTOU exists()/unlink() and exists()/mkdir() windows, WindowsPath '\\\\?\\' prefixing, archive-supplied posix_mode/lastwritetime) are documented in labels/phase1_review.md.

No sanitizer labels were confirmed: the relative_to containment checks at py7zr.py:577/:584 do run before file access but do NOT neutralize '..' traversal in this implementation (labeling them sanitizer/isBarrier would sever the real flow); remove_relative_path_marker strips only a leading './'. Sanitizer list is empty and the judgment is routed to the human-review gate -- see labels/phase1_review.md.

Constraint compliance: no PyVul ground truth (VULNERABILITY_AUDIT_REPORT.md, path_traversal_*.{csv,md} at the py7zr_vuln repo root), no patch diffs and no CVE advisories were consulted; source tree, CodeQL database, Augur installation and the Phase 1 CSVs were not modified.
